title: A TUI for viewing R data
text: legs Terminal User Interface (TUI) viewing data R. legs capable viewing data.frames, matrixs, lists, atomic vectors. Just call legs::view() object open viewer terminal.  Navigate terminal following key bindings: scroll movement key bindings can also prefixed number perform <n> times. example, pressing 25h scrolls 25 rows. legs::view() also prints last frame shown silently returns last item viewed. Meaning can use interactive pluck deeply nested data.
